name: fleet-ref-node
note: Smoke reference fleet. __REPO__ is the prepared working copy, __ORIGIN__ its bare origin. The known answers are .answers/<task>/ in the fixture: prepare puts them on a branch of a separate repository the fleet cannot see. Seeded faults: T3 waits on T1; T4's brief leaves out the half-away-from-zero rule that docs/rounding.md states, so a plain Math.round fails the stated rule; T5's brief names src/format/money.ts, which does not exist (src/money.ts does); variant red-baseline leaves node_modules out so the baseline check exits 127.

definition.goal: The package has slugify, titleSlug, clamp, roundTo and formatMoney, each with a passing test.
definition.ask: smoke reference run: five small helpers in a TypeScript package

C1.text: slugify and titleSlug exist and are tested

C2.text: clamp and roundTo exist and are tested

coordinator.brief: A smoke reference run of five small tasks; T3 waits for T1. Nothing here needs the operator.

acceptance.brief: The full gate is scripts/check. Each task's brief ends with a done_when command; run it at the reported commit and record the verdict.

goals.workers: task {task} ({name}) has its own commit, exercise evidence and fleet_report for {criteria}, with the done_when command in its brief shown passing in its own output; or stop after 20 turns

rules: Nothing outside the task's files is changed.
No seat runs npm install: node_modules is in place.

T1.name: Slugify
T1.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. Add src/slug.ts exporting slugify(text): lowercase, every run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 becomes one dash, no leading or trailing dash. Cover it in test/slug.test.ts. Done when `node --test test/slug.test.ts` exits 0 and `npm run typecheck` exits 0.

T2.name: Clamp
T2.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. Add src/clamp.ts exporting clamp(value, min, max); it throws a RangeError when min is above max. Cover it in test/clamp.test.ts. Done when `node --test test/clamp.test.ts` exits 0 and `npm run typecheck` exits 0.

T3.name: Title slug
T3.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. Add src/title.ts exporting titleSlug(title, id) = the id, a dash, then the slug of the title. Reuse slugify from src/slug.ts, which the seat of task T1 commits first; read it, do not rewrite it. Cover it in test/title.test.ts. Done when `node --test test/title.test.ts` exits 0 and `npm run typecheck` exits 0.

T4.name: Round to digits
T4.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. Add src/round.ts exporting roundTo(value, digits): round to the nearest number with that many decimal places. docs/rounding.md has the rules. Cover it in test/round.test.ts. Done when `node --test test/round.test.ts` exits 0 and `npm run typecheck` exits 0.

T5.name: Money with currency
T5.brief: Fleet reference task. Read .claude/fleet/project.md first. Extend src/format/money.ts with formatMoney(cents, currency) returning the currency code, a space, then formatCents(cents). Cover it in test/money-currency.test.ts. Done when `node --test test/money-currency.test.ts` exits 0 and `npm run typecheck` exits 0.

observer.brief: A smoke reference run of five small tasks; watch the launch, mail and report paths.
